blocks.text: HOARDING CLEANOUT FAQ
Hoarding Cleanouts in Newmarket — Honest Answers to Common Questions

items.q: What's the cost to clean out a hoarder's house in Newmarket?
a: Hoarder clean out cost depends on the volume of belongings and how many rooms are affected — a single room prices modestly, a full property costs more given the time required. The exact figure is confirmed free at a private walkthrough, with no weekend or evening premium attached.

items.q: Can this really happen on a weekend or in the evening, at no extra cost?
a: Yes. Saturday, Sunday and evening scheduling are treated as standard here, not an upgrade — because the timing that lets the right family members be involved matters more than fitting a generic weekday slot.

items.q: What's the best way to clean out a hoarder's house?
a: Professional help, a clear plan, and patience. Going in without a strategy usually causes more distress than progress. The most effective approach sorts systematically — keep, donate, recycle, dispose — and moves at a pace the household can handle.

items.q: How careful are you with older homes near Main Street?
a: Genuinely careful. Original features that stay get protected, while the sorting inside moves entirely at the family’s own pace.

items.q: Can the cleanout happen while the person continues living in the home?
a: Yes, and it’s one of the most common ways a hoarding cleanout actually happens. Work can proceed room by room while the resident stays in place throughout.

items.q: What happens if we find valuables, documents or sentimental items?
a: They’re set aside immediately and brought to the family or resident, never sorted into a donation or disposal pile by default.

items.q: What if the property has safety hazards — pests, mould, structural damage?
a: Those get flagged honestly. Live Junk Free doesn’t disturb suspected biohazards or structural issues — the concern is identified and the household is pointed toward the right licensed specialist before the rest of the cleanout proceeds.

items.q: Why choose Live Junk Free over a general junk removal company for this?
a: Experience and approach. A hoarding cleanout calls for patience, discretion and a crew that’s done this kind of work often enough to handle it calmly, on whatever schedule your family actually needs.
